annotations.title: Contract audit: Solidity security review by address or source

description: Contract audit for Solidity and Vyper: give a verified contract address (Ethereum, Base, Arbitrum, Optimism, Polygon) or paste the source, and one call returns security findings by severity with function, line, exploit scenario and fix, who holds the owner and upgrade keys on chain, a score and a Markdown report, in about a minute. Automated review, not a manual audit. Use before deploying, integrating with or buying into a contract. Price $1.00/call via x402 USDC or a card key (/credits); failed calls free. Reads or computes only and changes nothing; each call is charged, so repeats are not free.

address.description: Verified contract 0x address (a proxy is followed to its implementation). Send this or source

chain.description: ethereum (default), base, arbitrum, optimism or polygon; used with address

context.description: Optional notes for the reviewers, up to 1,000 characters: what the contract is for or what worries you

source.description: Solidity or Vyper source code, or the compiler's standard JSON input, up to 300,000 characters; POST it in a JSON body when it is long. Send this or address
